title: [DocDB] Build errors when building with --no-tcmalloc
body:
Jira Link: [DB-5972](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5972)
### Description

Building with the --no-tcmalloc flag results in errors:
```
/-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| COMPILATION FAILED
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: yb::docdb::EntryToString(yb::Slice const&, yb::Slice const&, yb::docdb::SchemaPackingStorage const&, yb::docdb::StorageDbType)
>>> referenced by kv_formatter.cc:29 (src/yb/tablet/kv_formatter.cc:29)
>>>               build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/tablet/CMakeFiles/tablet_metadata.dir/kv_formatter.cc.o:(yb::tablet::KVFormatter::Format(yb::Slice const&, yb::Slice const&, yb::docdb::StorageDbType) const)

ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: yb::docdb::DocReadContext::DocReadContext(std::__1::basic_string<char, std::__1::char_traits<char>, std::__1::allocator<char>> const&, yb::TableType)
>>> referenced by kv_formatter.cc:40 (src/yb/tablet/kv_formatter.cc:40)
>>>               build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/tablet/CMakeFiles/tablet_metadata.dir/kv_formatter.cc.o:(yb::tablet::KVFormatter::ProcessArgument(std::__1::basic_string<char, std::__1::char_traits<char>, std::__1::allocator<char>> const&))
>>> referenced by tablet_metadata.cc:121 (src/yb/tablet/tablet_metadata.cc:121)
>>>               build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/tablet/CMakeFiles/tablet_metadata.dir/tablet_metadata.cc.o:(yb::tablet::TableInfo::TableInfo(std::__1::basic_string<char, std::__1::char_traits<char>, std::__1::allocator<char>> const&, yb::TableType, yb::tablet::TableInfo::PrivateTag))

ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: yb::SchemaFromPB(yb::SchemaPB const&, yb::Schema*)
>>> referenced by doc_read_context.h:38 (src/yb/docdb/doc_read_context.h:38)
>>>               build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/tablet/CMakeFiles/tablet_metadata.dir/kv_formatter.cc.o:(yb::Status yb::docdb::DocReadContext::LoadFromPB<yb::tablet::TableInfoPB>(yb::tablet::TableInfoPB const&))

ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: yb::docdb::SchemaPackingStorage::LoadFromPB(google::protobuf::RepeatedPtrField<yb::docdb::SchemaPackingPB> const&)
>>> referenced by doc_read_context.h:39 (src/yb/docdb/doc_read_context.h:39)
>>>               build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/tablet/CMakeFiles/tablet_metadata.dir/kv_formatter.cc.o:(yb::Status yb::docdb::DocReadContext::LoadFromPB<yb::tablet::TableInfoPB>(yb::tablet::TableInfoPB const&))

[...]
```
